## CodeRabbit review

Public repositories with fewer than 10 stars require a manual review request,
even when automatic reviews are enabled. Bot-authored PRs may also be skipped.

Comment `@coderabbitai review` once when the PR head has no CodeRabbit status;
never when that status is pending or successful, and never
`@coderabbitai full review`. Each request spends review allowance. These
commands are instructions for an actual PR comment; text in this PR
description does not trigger them.

- [ ] Merge `main` into the branch before the first push.
- [ ] Request a CodeRabbit review only if the final PR head has no CodeRabbit
      status.
- [ ] Verify that the CodeRabbit status on the final PR head is successful; an
      incremental pass on a merge commit from `main` counts. A walkthrough,
      skipped notice or pending status alone is not review evidence.
- [ ] Address confirmed findings and record the review link and reviewed head
      SHA. If review cannot complete, record the reason for the maintainer.

Do not treat CodeRabbit as a substitute for CI or the repository's required
human/independent review. Maintainers decide whether to merge if CodeRabbit
is unavailable.
